lines.en: label beachsixtsuneyo1:
Today’s conquests in alphabetical order: Ayane.
lines.zh: 今日战果（按字母顺序排列）：Ayane。

lines.en: That’s it.
lines.zh: 就这些。

lines.en: After spending the bulk of yesterday spreading myself across the land like the worst version of Johnny Appleseed, I decided today should be a day of rest.
lines.zh: 昨天我花了一大半时间，像最糟糕版本的苹果佬约翰尼那样把自己撒遍这片土地，所以今天我决定当休息日。

lines.en: {size=-2}I figure that if I’m going to get called out by one of the most mild-mannered girls in school, the least I can do is cut back for twenty-four hours and only make love to the ones where it feels more {i}passionate{/i} and less carnal.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}我想，既然都被全校最温和的女生之一当面数落了，那我至少也该收敛二十四小时，只跟那些感觉上更偏「{i}做爱{/i}」、而非纯肉欲的对象温存。{/size}

lines.en: Plus, Ayane was a little upset after breakfast too. And it appears that my semen may serve as some sort of medicine for her as she is mostly fine now that she’s been conquered.
lines.zh: 再说，Ayane 早饭后也有点不高兴。而我的精液似乎对她有某种药效——被我征服之后，她现在基本没事了。

lines.en: Or is at least pretending to be fine — which essentially just {i}is{/i} being fine by Ayane’s standards, so I’m not about to tell her how to live her life.
lines.zh: 或者至少在装作没事——按 Ayane 的标准，装作没事基本上{i}就等于{/i}没事，所以我也不打算教她怎么过日子。

lines.en: She will tell me how to live mine, though. That there’s another gathering in this very room beginning in about two hours. And how I won’t be able to have any more sex until tomorrow.
lines.zh: 不过她会来教我怎么过我的日子。她说大约两小时后，就在这间屋子里还有一场聚会。还说在明天之前，我不能再做爱了。

lines.en: I don’t know if I could even if I wanted to, though. For she smiled in a way that no one else smiles just thirteen seconds before her biggest orgasm of the evening and it tore my sails in two.
lines.zh: 不过就算我想，我大概也不行了。因为就在她今晚最大的那次高潮前十三秒，她笑了——那种谁都不会有的笑法，把我的帆撕成了两半。

lines.en: {size=-2}And had she not already been immersed in the process of collapsing into my chest after each round of cowgirlish coitus, I’d have thought that it was her expression that knocked the wind out of me in that moment.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}若不是她每轮女上位结束之后都正瘫在我胸口上，我简直会以为，是她那个表情在那一刻把我肺里的空气全打了出来。{/size}

lines.en: Upon reflection, I think it was. Because the thought of anyone else smiling like that makes me sick to my stomach. So she’ll remain in my head as the only one I’m willing to inflict that upon.
lines.zh: 仔细想想，是的。因为一想到别人也那样笑，我就胃里翻江倒海。所以在我心里，她会是唯一一个我愿意把那种事加诸其身的人。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn1
That won’t stop me from mentally undressing other girls, though. And as I step into the hall for a moment of fresh air, I happen upon two lungs full of black mold and a gag in my mouth.
lines.zh: 不过这不妨碍我在脑子里把别的女孩子扒光。而当我走进走廊想透口气时，却撞上了两肺的黑霉和塞在嘴里的口塞。

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : I take it you’re here to see me and not Ayane, right?
lines.zh: : 我猜你是来找我的，不是找 Ayane，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. I just had a strange compulsion to stand outside of this door and wait for someone to exit. But I don’t know what to do now that you have.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。我只是突然有种奇怪的冲动，想站在这扇门外等某个人出来。可现在你出来了，我反倒不知道该做什么了。

lines.en: : Well, have you talked to Makoto at all? Because right now she’s-
lines.zh: : 那，你跟 Makoto 聊过了吗？因为现在她——

lines.en: : She has informed me that I am potentially important and that my presence is required for a pajama-based meeting here in two hours.
lines.zh: : 她通知我，我可能很重要，两小时后这里有一场睡衣会议，需要我出席。

lines.en: : I think it’d be perfectly fine if you kept the swimsuit on. In fact, I’d go so far as to encourage it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你继续穿着泳衣完全没问题。事实上，我甚至要鼓励你这么做。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn2
: I will consider this. But will my immaculate form not serve only to detract from the topics we are bound to discuss just a short while from now?
lines.zh: : 我会考虑的。不过我这副完美无瑕的身姿，难道不会反而让人分心，影响我们一会儿必然要讨论的话题吗？

lines.en: : It’ll be a pretty straight room, fortunately. I imagine any eyes on you other than mine will be of envy rather than lust.
lines.zh: : 幸好，那屋里的人应该都很正经。我想除了我之外，落在你身上的目光多半是嫉妒，而不是欲念。

lines.en: : Tell me — if you are so attracted to me, why have we not had sexual intercourse yet?
lines.zh: : 告诉我——既然你对我这么着迷，为什么我们还没有性交？

lines.en: : Uh-
: Is it because I am stronger than you and you are worried that I will take charge? Because you are likely correct.
lines.zh: : 是因为我比你强，你怕我会反过来主导吗？因为你这么想大概是对的。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, this...probably isn’t the place to just-
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，这……大概不是谈这个的地方——

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn3
: Then let us go outside and talk about sexual intercourse there.
lines.zh: : 那就到外面去，在那儿谈性交。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene black
: Let us go outside and talk about sexual-
lines.zh: : 我们到外面去谈性——

lines.en: : I heard what you said. I just don’t understand why you suddenly want to talk about this when we’ve never even {i}held hands{/i} before.
lines.zh: : 我听见你说什么了。我只是不明白，我们连{i}手都没牵过{/i}，你为什么突然想谈这个。

lines.en: : Yet you have carried my naked body in your arms. Is such a thing not closer to the final stage of a relationship than hand-holding?
lines.zh: : 可你曾经把我的裸体抱在怀里。这种事难道不比牵手更接近关系的最终阶段吗？

lines.en: : Well, one is far more consensual than the other.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，其中一个比另一个要合意得多。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn4
: Interesting. I had assumed consent was merely optional to adults and that you had not attempted to fuck me out of sheer politeness. And yes, I do speak of actual fucking this time.
lines.zh: : 有意思。我原以为对成年人来说，同意只是可选项，而你之前没试图肏我，纯粹是出于礼貌。是的，这次我说的就是真正的肏。

lines.en: : Uhh...well...it’s not {i}optional.{/i} But is there a reason you’re being so forward about this all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 呃……那个……这不是{i}可选项{/i}。不过你为什么突然这么主动？

lines.en: : Recently, I attempted to tell you something only for my mind to be commandeered by what the Emerald Guardian would describe as an “unseen entity.”
lines.zh: : 前些日子，我本想告诉你一件事，结果我的意识被翡翠守护者口中的「不可视之物」劫持了。

lines.en: : I would like to know why. And I believed engaging in similar conversation could potentially invoke such an experience again. So please, do your worst and fuck me right here.
lines.zh: : 我想知道为什么。而且我认为，进行类似的对话或许能再次招来那种体验。所以拜托了，尽管放马过来，就在这儿肏我。

lines.en: : I remain unfucked. Will a term of endearment spur you to action, perhaps? Please have sex with me, bro.
lines.zh: : 我依然没被肏。加个亲昵称呼能不能让你动起来？请和我做爱吧，老兄。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, that’s not-
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，那不是——

lines.en: : Put it inside of me, {i}big{/i} bro.
lines.zh: : 把它插进我里面，{i}大{/i}哥。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn5
: ...Closer. Something’s still not right, though.
lines.zh: : ……接近了。不过还是有什么地方不对。

lines.en: : I agree. Which is why I have decided to go through with such a heinous act in the first place. If I need to give up my autonomy to save my autonomy, so be it.
lines.zh: : 我同意。这正是我一开始决定做出这种十恶不赦之事的原因。如果需要交出自主权才能保住自主权，那就这样吧。

lines.en: : And frankly, I am just not very good at masturbating. I have tried several times and it mostly just feels odd.
lines.zh: : 而且坦白说，我不太会自慰。试过好几次，感觉大多只是怪怪的。

lines.en: : How much of that...{i}talk{/i} do you remember? The one where you told me about your...supernatural sex dream, for lack of a better term.
lines.zh: : 那次……{i}谈话{/i}你还记得多少？就是你跟我说你那个……超自然性梦的那次——找不到更好的说法了。

lines.en: : Because I assumed it was sort of just...purged from your mind afterwards. Similar stuff happens to me sometimes when my thoughts are “commandeered.”
lines.zh: : 因为我以为事后它会……从你脑子里被清掉。我有时候也会遇到类似的事，当我的念头被「劫持」的时候。

lines.en: : But you’ve remembered things in the past that you probably {i}shouldn’t{/i} have, so...maybe you’re special in some way.
lines.zh: : 可你以前也记得过一些本{i}不该{/i}记得的东西，所以……也许你在某方面很特别。

lines.en: : I am special in many ways. You are right to acknowledge this.
lines.zh: : 我在很多方面都很特别。你承认这一点是对的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn6
: In terms of what I remember, however, the details are still somewhat foggy.
lines.zh: : 不过就我记得的部分而言，细节还有些模糊。

lines.en: : I recall stepping away from Tojo Ramen and walking with you. Then stopping near a spot that overlooks the town.
lines.zh: : 我记得从 Tojo 拉面店出来，和你一起走。然后在俯瞰小镇的一个地方停下。

lines.en: : I remember telling you about the dream. And then you being surprised. And then I believe my head started to hurt, but...
lines.zh: : 我记得跟你说了那个梦。然后是你的惊讶。然后我想我的头开始疼了，不过……

lines.en: : The memories appear to cut off there.
lines.zh: : 记忆似乎就断在那里了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn7
: Have we already had sex and it was just so unremarkable that I didn’t bother to remember it?
lines.zh: : 会不会我们已经做过了，只是平淡到我不屑于记住？

lines.en: : You’d remember it.
lines.zh: : 你会记得的。

lines.en: : I would hope so after all of the practice you have gotten. But you are mostly unimpressive in every other aspect of life, so I would not be shocked if this was any different.
lines.zh: : 就凭你练了那么多次，我也希望如此。不过你在人生其他方面基本都乏善可陈，所以就算这件事也一样，我也不会惊讶。

lines.en: : Insults aside, I’ve actually been wanting to talk to you about this too.
lines.zh: : 侮辱的话先放一边，其实我也一直想跟你谈这个。

lines.en: : I just...didn’t really know {i}how{/i} since it all went by so quickly and I’m used to stuff like that just not even registering to anyone else.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不太知道{i}怎么{/i}开口，因为一切都发生得太快，而且我已经习惯了这种事在别人那里根本留不下痕迹。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn8
: It’s been happening more often lately, though. And now it’s actually {i}sticking{/i} for some people.
lines.zh: : 不过最近这种事发生得越来越频繁了。而且现在有些人是真的{i}记住了{/i}。

lines.en: : Like Nao, for example. Just the other day, she and I got thrown into some weird...waiting room dimension thing and then spit back out like it was nothing. We both remember it too.
lines.zh: : 比如 Nao。就在前几天，她和我被扔进某个奇怪的……候诊室一样的异次元，然后又像什么都没发生过一样被吐了出来。我们俩也都记得。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn9
: And, come to think of it, she showed up not long after your mind broke that day. So maybe she’s somehow involved and just...not saying anything?
lines.zh: : 而且想想看，她是在那天你的意识崩溃之后不久出现的。所以也许她也牵涉其中，只是……什么都没说？

lines.en: : I apologize for being the one to break this news to you, but Nao-chan is incapable of speaking.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉由我来告诉你这个消息，但 Nao-chan 是无法说话的。

lines.en: : Nor do I believe she should be involved in conversations about sexual intercourse. But I understand that you are less opposed to the inclusion of children in such areas than I am.
lines.zh: : 我也不认为她该被卷进关于性交的对话里。不过我理解，在这类领域，你对「把小孩算进来」的抵触比我小。

lines.en: : It’s worth thinking about at least, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 至少值得想一想，不是吗？

lines.en: : Again, I can not police what you do in your mind. But we are talking about mine right now, and there are no children present there.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，你脑子里做什么我管不着。可我们现在谈的是我的脑子，而那里没有小孩在场。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn10
: Please just tell me what happened next...where my memories cut out. And whether or not you subsequently defiled the temple that is my body.
lines.zh: : 请直接告诉我后来发生了什么……我的记忆断在哪里。以及你之后有没有玷污我这座身体神殿。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn11
: You weren’t really in any condition to be walking...and I wasn’t about to just leave you in the middle of the road, so I picked you up and carried you back to the ramen shop.
lines.zh: : 你那状态根本走不了路……我又不能把你丢在大马路上，所以就把你抱起来，背回了拉面店。

lines.en: : Interesting. I am once again surprised you possess the strength to lift me at all.
lines.zh: : 有意思。你居然有力气把我抱起来，这又一次让我惊讶。

lines.en: : I tried calling out for your dad to see if he could, you know, come down and take you off of my hands. But when he didn’t respond, I assumed he was just too sick to.
lines.zh: : 我试着喊你爸，看他能不能，你知道的，下楼来把你从我手上接过去。可他没应声，我就当他病得太重了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn12
: So I brought you upstairs myself — where that assumption subsequently changed into something else entirely.
lines.zh: : 于是我自己把你抱上了楼——而那个猜测到那儿就彻底变成了另一回事。

lines.en: : Customers are not allowed on the top floor of Tojo Ramen. How unfair that you have found a loophole to store policy by being present while I was undergoing demonic possession.
lines.zh: : Tojo 拉面店的二楼是不允许客人上去的。你趁着被恶魔附身的时候在场，就找到了店规的漏洞，这多不公平。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo...don’t take this the wrong way or anything, but...
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo……你别往歪处想，不过……

lines.en: : Do you even {i}have{/i} a father?
lines.zh: : 你到底{i}有{/i}没有父亲？

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn13
: I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : It’s just...there was nothing {i}there.{/i} It was all just {i}white{/i} apart from a single door that was blocked off. And when I tried to open it, you...
lines.zh: : 只是……{i}那里{/i}什么都没有。全是一片{i}白{/i}，除了一扇被封起来的门。而当我试着去开那扇门的时候，你……

lines.en: : Well? What did I do?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？我做了什么？

lines.en: : Stripped naked and started begging me to have sex with you.
lines.zh: : 脱光了衣服，开始求我跟你做爱。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn14
: In my own {i}home?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 在我自己{i}家里？……{/i}

lines.en: : When did I become such a whore?
lines.zh: : 我是什么时候变成这种婊子的？

lines.en: : Tsuneyo...what the fuck is going on with your house? Why is it like that? What’s behind that door?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo……你家到底是怎么回事？为什么会是那样？那扇门后面是什么？

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn15
: Which door? There are several.
lines.zh: : 哪扇门？有好几扇呢。

lines.en: : There...was only one, I think. Apart from the one we entered from at least.
lines.zh: : 那里……好像只有一扇。至少除了我们进来的那扇之外。

lines.en: : But sure, assuming there was another I just didn’t see, what’s behind the one covered in caution tape?
lines.zh: : 好吧，就算还有一扇我没看见——那扇贴着警示胶带的门后面是什么？

lines.en: : Caution tape?
lines.zh: : 警示胶带？

lines.en: : Yeah...What are you hiding in there? Why go to such lengths to block off something in your own home?
lines.zh: : 对啊……你在里面藏了什么？至于这么大费周章，把自己家里的什么东西封起来吗？

lines.en: : Sensei — is it possible that {i}your{/i} memories of that night have been somehow manipulated as well? Because what you’re describing doesn’t sound like my home at all.
lines.zh: : 先生——有没有可能，{i}您{/i}对那天晚上的记忆也被人动了手脚？因为您描述的那个样子，根本不像我家。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn16
: What? But then...
lines.zh: : 什么？可那样的话……

lines.en: : Is it...possible your perception of that place is just warped entirely? Like...maybe you just started {i}pretending{/i} to see it as something it’s not as some kind of...coping mechanism or-
lines.zh: : 有没有可能……您对那个地方的感知整个扭曲了？比如……也许您开始{i}假装{/i}它是什么别的东西，作为一种……应对机制或者——

lines.en: : No, hold on. I’ve saved pictures of it since I would not allow the Emerald Guardian upstairs either and she wanted to know what it looked like.
lines.zh: : 不，等等。我存过那儿的照片——因为我也不让翡翠守护者上楼，而她又想知道楼上什么样。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn17
: Here. This is the living room. It’s what you’ll see the moment you enter the home.
lines.zh: : 你看。这是客厅。一进门就会看到的地方。

lines.en: : What? That’s not-
lines.zh: : 什么？这不是——

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn18
: And this is where I sleep. My father is in the room beside mine and the restroom is to the right of his door.
lines.zh: : 这是我睡觉的地方。我父亲在我隔壁那间，洗手间在他房门的右边。

lines.en: : I...I don’t-
: I have learned from the Green Onion about an application called “FaceTime” recently. If you are that curious, I could call you from it and give you a more formal tour.
lines.zh: : 我最近从「青葱」那里学会了一个叫「FaceTime」的应用。您要是那么好奇，我可以用它打给您，带您正式参观一遍。

lines.en: : All I ask is to omit my father’s room as I do not want to disturb him.
lines.zh: : 唯一的请求是略过我父亲的房间，因为我不想打扰他。

lines.en: : But...all the white and...and the writing on the walls...
lines.zh: : 可是……那一片白，还有……墙上的那些字……

lines.en: : What did...where {i}was{/i} I then? I don’t understand...
lines.zh: : 那我……我那是{i}在哪儿{/i}？我不明白……

lines.en: : Perhaps you were experiencing another one of those moments you mentioned several minutes ago? Being pulled into a peculiar dimension for a short time?
lines.zh: : 也许您又经历了一次您几分钟前提到的那种状况？被短暂地拉进某个奇异的次元？

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian has flagged me as a potential time traveler, so I believe I am an authority on interdimensional travel and am willing to lend some credibility to your cause.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者曾把我标记为潜在的时间旅行者，所以我认为自己在次元旅行方面算是权威，也愿意为您的说法提供一点可信度。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn19
: But it...felt so real...
lines.zh: : 可那……感觉那么真实……

lines.en: : I can...still smell it...I can hear the sound of your voice echoing off the walls...Remember how blinding the fluorescent light was.
lines.zh: : 我……还闻得到那味道……还听得到你的声音在墙上回响……记得那荧光灯有多刺眼吗。

lines.en: : But you can also remember the specifics of a place you have already confirmed to be fictitious, correct? The waiting room where you found a god?
lines.zh: : 可您也能记起一个您已经确认是虚构的地方的细节，对吧？那个您遇见了神的候诊室？

lines.en: : Yeah, but-
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过——

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn20
: Did I...
lines.zh: : 我有没有……

lines.en: : Mention meeting a god there?
lines.zh: : 提到过在那里遇见了神？

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn21
: Nao-chan! Cease the forward momentum of your youthful footarms!
lines.zh: : Nao-chan！停止你那稚嫩脚臂的前进势头！

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn22
: I am too unyoung to maintain up at this point!
lines.zh: : 我已经太不年轻，撑不下去了！

lines.en: : Nao...she’s here again.
lines.zh: : Nao……她又来了。

scene tsuneyohallinn24

lines.en: : Shouldn’t I be asking you that?...
lines.zh: : 这话不该我问你吗？……

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn25
: Why do the two of you keep popping up in the middle of everything weird lately? It’s like ever since Halloween, you’re practically at the forefront of it.
lines.zh: : 你们俩最近怎么老是在各种怪事的正中间冒出来？就好像万圣节之后，你们简直站在了最前线。

lines.en: : Weird? What is weird? What does the mattering right now, Friend? Why are your eye mustaches angled in such a distrustful way?
lines.zh: : 怪事？什么是怪事？朋友，现在到底怎么了？你的眼胡为什么翘成这么不信任的角度？

lines.en: : Whose idea was it to come here, Kaori?...Yours? Or Nao’s?
lines.zh: : 来这儿是谁的主意，Kaori？……你的？还是 Nao 的？

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn26
: It was Nao-chan’s idea. This is merely my attempt to facilitate her happiness as a devoted mothermom.
lines.zh: : 是 Nao-chan 的主意。我只是作为一个尽职的妈妈，想帮她实现快乐罢了。

lines.en: : Interesting. Let us hope that her appearance tonight does not predict yet another anomaly in our daily lives.
lines.zh: : 有意思。但愿她今晚的出现不会预示着我们日常生活中又一次异常。

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn27
: What is “anomaly?” If Nao-chan did something wrong, please allow me to be the one to punish her. I do not trust the ramen girl.
lines.zh: : 「异常」是什么？如果 Nao-chan 做错了什么，请让我来惩罚她。我不信任那个拉面女孩。

lines.en: : Trust is a two-way street and this road is closed. Be gone, spider woman. It’s {i}my{/i} turn to get fucked.
lines.zh: : 信任是双向车道，而这条路已经封闭。退下吧，蜘蛛女。这回该轮到{i}我{/i}被肏了。

lines.en: : No one is doing any {i}fucking{/i} right now.
lines.zh: : 现在谁也不会{i}肏{/i}谁。

lines.en: : Darn.
lines.zh: : 可恶。

lines.en: : And while I {i}do{/i} want to know why Nao was suddenly compelled to come to the beach just in time for {i}more{/i} weird shit, I have a more important question for her first.
lines.zh: : 虽然我{i}确实{/i}想知道 Nao 为什么突然被驱使着赶到海滩、正好又赶上{i}更多{/i}怪事，但我有一个更重要的问题要先问她。

lines.en: : Nao. Do you remember finding me upstairs in the ramen shop?
lines.zh: : Nao。你还记得在拉面店二楼找到我的事吗？

lines.en: : Do you remember what it {i}looked{/i} like?
lines.zh: : 你还记得那是什么{i}样子{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Kaori? What-
lines.zh: : Kaori？什么——

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn28
: Shh! My earmouths are feasting upon the sounds of her brainthoughts.
lines.zh: : 嘘！我的耳嘴正在享用她脑思的声音。

lines.en: : Well?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？

lines.en: : Nao-chan says it a was a traditional style 2LDK home that smelled faintly of pork broth and looked like it hadn’t been dusted in a long time.
lines.zh: : Nao-chan 说那是一间传统风格的 2LDK 住宅，隐约有猪骨汤的味道，而且看起来很久没掸过灰了。

lines.en: : Nonsense. I dust it every other year.
lines.zh: : 胡说。我每隔一年就掸一次。

lines.en: : You don’t remember a white room, Nao?
lines.zh: : 你不记得有白色的房间吗，Nao？

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn29
: She remembers nothing of the sort.
lines.zh: : 她完全不记得有那种东西。

lines.en: : And what about Amber? Do you remember {i}her?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那 Amber 呢？你记得{i}她{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyohallinn30
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 记得。

lines.en: : Huh...
Why is it just Tsuneyo’s house that eludes her then? Unless...
lines.zh: 那为什么偏偏只有 Tsuneyo 的家被她跳过了？除非……

lines.en: Unless {i}I{/i} was the one perceiving it incorrectly. But what reason would {i}I{/i} have to warp the state of her home into something so...sterile?
lines.zh: 除非是{i}我{/i}自己感知错了。可{i}我{/i}有什么理由要把她家的样子扭曲成那么……无菌的东西？

lines.en: I’m probably dwelling on this a little too much. And it probably won’t change anything in the long run.
lines.zh: 我大概在这件事上钻牛角尖了。而且长远来看，这大概也改变不了什么。

lines.en: But little by little, more cracks in the fabric of reality keep showing up. So either the world is breaking, or {i}I{/i} am. And neither of these things are good for {i}any{/i} of us.
lines.zh: 可现实这块布上的裂缝，正一点点越来越多。所以要么是世界在崩坏，要么是{i}我{/i}在崩坏。而这两样对我们{i}谁{/i}都没好处。

lines.en: What can we do to fix it, though? Because just knowing something is broken doesn’t teach us how to do that.
lines.zh: 可我们能做什么去修补它呢？因为光知道某样东西坏了，并不会教你怎么修。

lines.en: And leaving things alone might break them even more, so the solution seems at first glance to just {i}build{/i} more.
lines.zh: 而放着不管说不定会坏得更厉害，所以乍看之下，解决办法似乎就是多{i}建{/i}一点。

lines.en: Can what we build really outpace the destruction of everything else, though? And, if it can’t, how long do we have left before we’re buried beneath the rubble of options never explored?
lines.zh: 可我们建起来的东西，真能跑赢其他一切的崩塌吗？如果不能，我们还有多久就会被埋在那些从未尝试过的可能性的废墟之下？

lines.en: scene black
I’m not quite sure, to be honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，我不太确定。

lines.en: But thinking so intensely about it works up an appetite.
lines.zh: 不过这么费劲地想下去，倒是想出胃口来了。

$ tsuneyo_love += 1
jump beachsixtsuneyo2
